ItemID: NA; Title: Christmas Voices; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits my interest in Christmas vocal music, but I am more interested in everyday listening right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My Downton Christmas album suggests some interest, but I would save this for the holidays.
ItemID: NA; Title: Montevallo; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My country listening makes this plausible, but it is less compelling than the orchestral and vocal choices here.
ItemID: NA; Title: Influence Vol. 2: The Man I Am; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I occasionally listen to country, but this would not be my first choice for my current quieter mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets appeal to the polished ensemble singing I enjoyed in A Musical Affair and Under One Sky.
ItemID: NA; Title: All That Echoes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having listened to Stages, I would be interested in more expressive vocals from Josh Groban.
ItemID: NA; Title: Title; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Upbeat contemporary pop is less suited to what I want after my recent relaxing classical listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Songs From The Silver Screen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Film songs and orchestral vocals connect with my enjoyment of Downton Abbey music and Stages.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Essential Mary Chapin Carpenter; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My country albums give this some relevance, but I do not feel drawn enough to explore a retrospective this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: To Be Loved; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Warm vocals and familiar standards sound appealing alongside my interest in melodic vocal albums.
